bead.title: Introduce JSON entity document compatibility for pqueue items
bead.description: Introduce the canonical JSON representation that schema validation and axon_esf index_key consume. Current public NewItem uses payload: Option<Bytes> and fields: BTreeMap<String, Bytes>; keep existing bytes workflows working while adding a typed entity/document path. In-scope files: crates/pqueue/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs, crates/pqueue-core/src/domain.rs as needed, serialization/replay tests. Define how legacy fields map to JSON for old queues and how typed queues require JSON values. Ensure vectorized commit lifecycle_items have the same representation and compatibility behavior as push. Out-of-scope: actual schema validation and index maintenance.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue facade::update_fields_merges_versions_and_cas_over_memory request_id_idempotency -- --nocapture passes; cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests -- --nocapture passes; new tests prove legacy Bytes items still push/claim and typed JSON items round-trip through push/commit.
